description:
Open-records requests Georgia Prisoners' Speak made to Georgia agencies under the Georgia Open
    Records Act, published with every document the agency released, so a cited source can be checked.
    Without ref: the list of published requests (reference, title, agency, dates, status, document
    count). With ref (e.g. 'R032544-101826'): the request as sent, the agency's answers and fee
    estimate, and every file with its URL, page count and SHA-256. q searches titles, summaries and
    request text; agency filters by agency or its short name (GDC). Example: ref='R032544-101826' is
    GDC's drone-detection purchase orders (AirWarden, 2017-2025). Reader page: https://gps.press/records/
name: get_public_records
title: Get public records
